title: test: pin the replay's CQ-V08b keep for a strong journal whose replayed finalize is lost (shared and worktree, both wrappers)
description:
QA finding from task-527735ea (CQ-M07t), completion e6c06b00. Not a defect: the code is correct by inspection.

GAP. receipt_replay (scripts/moe-agent.sh) and Invoke-MoeReceiptReplay (moe-agent.ps1) keep a strong journal while its attempt is not closed ("receipt journal ... kept: attempt ... is <phase>, not closed; nothing finalized."). CQ-M07t relaxed that guard to cover worktree journals by dropping `[ -z "$wt" ]` / `-not $wt`. No test reaches that branch:
- In [strong receipt] SR-T2-replay (postflight-vm-route.{sh,ps1}) the replayed finalize succeeds.
- postflight.sh's reconcile-strong-finalize-lost loses finalize only in run 1, and its replay also succeeds.
Reverting the guard change survives every current row.

ASK. Add one row per wrapper in which the replay's finalize_attempt is refused, for example the SR-T2 kept project replayed under FAKE_EVIDENCE_MODE=finalize_attempt-refuse. Assert that the receipt is re-sent, the line above appears once, the attempt stays finalizing, and the journal stays on disk. Then add the same row for a shared strong journal if it fits the budget. Test files only; the gate stays within the 20-minute rail.
definitionOfDone: postflight-vm-route.sh and .ps1 each have a row in which a strong worktree journal's replayed finalize_attempt is refused: the receipt is re-sent, the 'not closed; nothing finalized.' line appears exactly once, the attempt stays finalizing and the journal stays on disk.
Reverting CQ-M07t's guard relaxation in receipt_replay (or in Invoke-MoeReceiptReplay) makes that row fail.
postflight-vm-route.sh, plus postflight-vm-route.ps1 under PS 5.1 and pwsh 7, parity-check.{sh,ps1} and npm run lint pass.

implementationPlan.description:
postflight-vm-route.ps1: the twin of step 1. Same two rows, same assertions, byte-identical expected lines. Constraints:
- Keep the file ASCII; it holds no non-ASCII byte today.
- PS 5.1 syntax only: no ??, no ternary, no && or || chains.
- Avoid the traps in mem:gotcha-ps1-harness-syntax-traps. Wrap scriptblock calls in @(...) so a single result keeps .Count on 5.1. Pick no variable whose name differs only by case from one Assert-SrRow already uses ($B, $C, $n, $of, $j, $kept, $keys and so on).

(a) Invoke-SrRows: add the rows right after `Assert-SrRow $r replay`, before SR-T3. Each uses the existing try { $r = Invoke-SgRow ... } finally { $script:VmrSetup = { Initialize-SgFixture } } shape. Sketch, not yet dry-run:
    $script:VmrSetup = { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $project -Recurse -Force; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $keep -Destination $project -Recurse -Force }
    try { $r = Invoke-SgRow SR-T2-refuse @{ FAKE_ATTEMPT_PROFILE = 'verified-local'; MOE_CHECK_DISPATCH_PATH = $sgFake; FAKE_CLAIM_MODE = 'finalizing'; FAKE_EVIDENCE_MODE = 'finalize_attempt-refuse' } }
    finally { $script:VmrSetup = { Initialize-SgFixture } }
    Assert-SrRow $r refused
    $script:VmrSetup = {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $project -Recurse -Force; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $keep -Destination $project -Recurse -Force
        $af = Join-Path $project '.moe/attempts/attempt-postflight.json'; $t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($af)
        if ([regex]::Matches($t, '"phase":"finalizing"').Count -ne 1) { throw "the kept attempt is not finalizing: $t" }
        [IO.File]::WriteAllText($af, $t.Replace('"phase":"finalizing"', '"phase":"running"'))
    }
    try { $r = Invoke-SgRow SR-T2-running @{ FAKE_ATTEMPT_PROFILE = 'verified-local'; MOE_CHECK_DISPATCH_PATH = $sgFake; FAKE_CLAIM_MODE = 'finalizing' } }
    finally { $script:VmrSetup = { Initialize-SgFixture } }
    Assert-SrRow $r running
The fake proxy writes the attempt record with JSON.stringify, so the compact '"phase":"finalizing"' occurs exactly once. WriteAllText writes UTF-8 with no BOM. Do not round-trip the record through ConvertFrom-Json and ConvertTo-Json: pwsh 7 turns its ISO timestamps into DateTime.
(b) Assert-SrRow: add one branch for both kinds after the deferred branch, ending in `return`, with step 1 (b)'s assertions:
- $lost holds the exact still-finalizing line.
- $open counts lines that StartsWith '[WARN] receipt journal ' and EndsWith ' kept: attempt attempt-postflight of task task-postflight is running, not closed; nothing finalized.'.
- The kept-copy journal is [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $tempRoot 'sr-keep/.git/moe/receipt/task-postflight.json')).
- Both kinds: $rec.Count is 2 and (& $canon $rec[1].args) -ceq (& $canon $rec[0].args), compared in the port's sorted-key form as the replay kind does. Exactly one check-dispatch row, one '[receipt] replaying the delivery receipt of task task-postflight from ' line, no deferral line, and Test-Path $jf with [IO.File]::ReadAllText($jf) -ceq the kept copy.
- refused: $fin.Count is 3 (Send-MoeEvidence's 3 tries), all outcome landed with landedRevision $C. $phase is 'finalizing', one $lost line, no line containing ' not closed; nothing finalized.', and $kept is 0.
- running: $fin.Count is 0, $phase is 'running', $open is 1, $kept is 1, and no $lost line.
(c) Update the section's header comment and its two Write-Host lines to match step 1 (c).

Error handling: a throw in a setup scriptblock fails the row through the existing try/finally. An Assert-Sg failure names the row and prints the wrapper output.

Verification, once. Run checkRefs[0] exactly as written, from any cwd.

What it does: it cds into this row's task worktree at scripts/tests, so every harness tests W's own wrapper, and unsets MOE_*, CLAUDE* and FAKE_*. Then it runs three legs in parallel:
- powershell (5.1) and pwsh (7): each runs `pwsh.exe -nop -c "cmd /c <e> -nop -ep Bypass -f postflight-vm-route.ps1&&<e> -nop -ep Bypass -f postflight.ps1"`. The cmd hop keeps pwsh's PSModulePath for vm-route, as CI's node hop does; postflight.ps1 runs direct.
- bash: postflight-vm-route.sh, postflight.sh, parity-check.sh, parity-check.ps1 under pwsh, and npm run lint.
MOE_FROZEN_TEST_ONLY=reconcile-strong-finalize-lost,reconcile-strong-replay-running reaches Windows through WSLENV. It makes postflight.sh and postflight.ps1 run only those two frozen modes and exit. The ref passes only with three '@' legs and three 'scenarios: 2' lines, so a misspelled filter cannot go green by running nothing.

Timing: on d35f2bc3, with the old one-mode filter, the same chain took 454 s at load ~5 (CHAIN_EXIT=0). The new rows add well under a minute per leg, inside the 20-minute rail. The full postflight.sh and postflight.ps1 run in no task gate (PR CI and the nightly run them). DoD 3 is checkRefs[0].

Then the mutants: DoD 2, plus proof that each new row has teeth. Set each one up in its own scratch snapshot on D:, never in W:
  S=/mnt/d/moe-scratch/9194-<m>-$(date +%s); mkdir -p $S && git -C <W> archive HEAD scripts packages/moe-daemon/src/state/validators.ts | tar -x -C $S
Change ONE line of $S/scripts/moe-agent.sh or .ps1 with a sed or python replace. Check that the diff against W shows exactly that line: a replace that matched nothing makes a false survivor. Run only the named harness, from a /mnt/d cwd, with the same unset and exports as checkRefs[0]. Each must exit non-zero at the named row:
- M1 (DoD 2, sh): CQ-M07t's revert. Restore `[ -z "$wt" ] && ` after `[ -n "$strong" ] && ` in receipt_replay's CQ-V08b check. bash $S/scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.sh fails at SR-T2-running ('the strong journal was not kept byte for byte'), after SR-T2-refuse passed. Proven on d35f2bc3.
- M2 (DoD 2, ps1): restore `-not $wt -and ` after `$strong -and ` in Invoke-MoeReceiptReplay's check. pwsh.exe -nop -ep Bypass -f <$S as a D: path>/scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.ps1 fails at SR-T2-running.
- M3 (sh, shared): in the same sh check, add `[ -n "$wt" ] && ` instead, so only worktree journals are kept. MOE_FROZEN_TEST_ONLY=reconcile-strong-replay-running bash $S/scripts/tests/postflight.sh fails in that mode (journal false, kept 0). Proven on d35f2bc3; M1 leaves this mode green, as it should.
- M4 (ps1, shared): add `$wt -and ` after `$strong -and ` in the ps1 check. postflight.ps1 under the same filter (pwsh, with WSLENV) throws 'Frozen candidate scenarios failed'.
- M5 (sh and ps1): drop the `continue` after the 'still finalizing after its replayed receipt' warning (sh: the line after that echo; ps1: the '; continue' inside that if). The vm-route harness fails at SR-T2-refuse, because the journal is then removed. The sh half was proven on d35f2bc3.
Run the mutants in parallel from separate snapshots; each run uses its own temp dirs. Record each mutant's exit code and failing row in the completion summary.

Error handling for a red run:
- Read $L/<leg>. Find that dir with `find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -name 'tmp.*' -newer <a file touched just before the run>`, not ls -t.
- Rerun that harness alone in the same env, to tell a real failure from WSL interop (mem:gotcha-qa-ps1-postflight-from-wsl). A leg that printed only 'UtilAcceptVsock ... failed 110' never started; rerun the whole gate.
- A row that is red on the parent revision's scripts too is not this task's: report it, do not fix it here.
- Kill only PIDs this session started.

Adversarial self-review of this diff, the final step: use the adversarial-self-review skill.
(1) Test files only: `git diff --stat $(git merge-base HEAD ${MOE_LAND_TARGET:-HEAD})` lists exactly the four harness files.
(2) No assertion passes when the code does nothing. Each new row has a killing mutant from step 4: M1 and M2 kill SR-T2-running, M5 kills SR-T2-refuse, M3 and M4 kill the frozen mode.
(3) No existing row is weakened. Every pre-existing sr_check and Assert-SrRow assertion, and every other frozen mode, is byte-unchanged; T1-T4 and finalize-lost still pass.
(4) sh/ps1 parity: same rows and same expected lines in both. The two embedded suites are identical (step 3's diff). postflight.ps1 keeps its BOM and its non-ASCII line count, and postflight-vm-route.ps1 stays ASCII.
(5) Determinism: no row depends on timing or on directory order, and the fixture rewrites fail loudly on drift.
(6) Wrong assumptions: if task-a1f3723f or task-edf2162b changed the replay, the rows assert the landed text, and the summary says so.
End the completion summary with the DoD map:
- DoD 1: SR-T2-refuse plus SR-T2-running on both harnesses. This is the human's 2026-11-04 decision, because a refused replayed finalize never reaches the CQ-V08b line.
- DoD 2: M1 and M2.
- DoD 3: checkRefs[0].

comments.author: architect-2a219562
comments.content:
Architect, planning session 2026-11-04 ~23:30Z. The human decided this row's DoD question in the planning REPL.

The problem: DoD 1's setup never reaches the branch it names. When the replay's finalize_attempt is refused, both wrappers print '[WARN] attempt <aid> is still finalizing after its replayed receipt; its finalizing holds stay until it closes.' and `continue` before the CQ-V08b check (moe-agent.sh:6696, moe-agent.ps1:2525 at d35f2bc3). So that row never prints 'not closed; nothing finalized.', and it survives the guard-revert mutant DoD 2 asks for. The CQ-V08b check runs only when the pinned attempt phase is neither finalizing nor closed.

The human chose:
1. Both rows in each vm-route harness, so DoD 1 is met by the pair:
   - SR-T2-refuse uses DoD 1's own setup. The receipt is re-sent, the 'still finalizing' line appears once and no 'not closed' line, the attempt stays finalizing, and the journal is kept byte for byte.
   - SR-T2-running: the kept attempt reads running. The receipt is re-sent, no finalize is sent, 'is running, not closed; nothing finalized.' appears once, and the journal is kept. DoD 2's mutant kills this row.
2. Include the shared strong-journal row as the frozen mode reconcile-strong-replay-running in postflight.sh and postflight.ps1, gated through MOE_FROZEN_TEST_ONLY.

The DoD text is unchanged; it is human-owned. QA: please review DoD 1 against the pair.

Bash dry run on d35f2bc3: both vm-route rows and the frozen mode are green. Each mutant fails its target:
- the guard revert fails SR-T2-running;
- dropping the refused-finalize `continue` fails SR-T2-refuse;
- a worktree-only keep fails the frozen mode.

- SR-T2-running: the kept attempt reads running. The receipt is re-sent, no finalize_attempt is sent, 'receipt journal ... kept: attempt attempt-postflight of task task-postflight is running, not closed; nothing finalized.' appears once, the attempt stays running, and the journal is kept byte for byte.
The frozen-candidate suite embedded in postflight.sh and postflight.ps1 gains reconcile-strong-replay-running, the same CQ-V08b keep for a shared strong journal. Reverting CQ-M07t's guard relaxation fails SR-T2-running on each wrapper.

- receipt_send runs before the phase read.
- A refused finalize prints the 'still finalizing after its replayed receipt' warning and continues (~6696).
- The CQ-V08b check `if [ -n "$strong" ] && [ "$phase" != closed ] && [ -e "$f" ]` (~6703) prints 'receipt journal $f kept: attempt $aid of task $tid is $phase, not closed; nothing finalized.'

scripts/moe-agent.ps1 Invoke-MoeReceiptReplay (~2416) has the same at ~2525 and ~2530-2533. Its removal is `if ($wt) { Remove-Item ... } elseif ($strong) { Remove-Item ... }`.

The phase reads (moe_pinned_attempt_phase, Get-MoePinnedAttemptPhase) come from .moe/attempts/<id>.json. reattach_own_attempts and Invoke-MoeReattachOwnAttempts touch only reconciling records, and run after the replay.

- FAKE_CLAIM_MODE=finalizing refuses with ATTEMPT_FINALIZING only while the seat holds a finalizing attempt; otherwise it answers hasNext:false.
- '<tool>-refuse' refuses without touching the attempt.
- receiptReply stores the first receipt and answers duplicate:true to an identical repeat.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
- DoD 1's literal row alone (finalize_attempt-refuse on the SR-T2 kept project) was rejected as the only row. Both wrappers continue before the CQ-V08b check on a refused replay finalize, so the row never prints the 'not closed' line and survives the guard-revert mutant. It is kept as SR-T2-refuse, the pin for that keep path. The human chose both rows in the planning REPL.
- Reaching the check with a reconciling attempt also works, since the replay runs before reattach_own_attempts. But the reattach right after flips the record to running, which muddies the 'phase unchanged' assertion. 'running' is left alone by reattach and is one of the phases the replay's own comment names.
- An unreadable or missing attempt record (phase 'mismatch') would also reach the check, but it prints 'is mismatch' and reads as contrived.
- A second replay inside reconcile-strong-finalize-lost was rejected: a separate mode leaves that row's assertions untouched.
- A fake-proxy knob for the running phase is unneeded: the harness rewrites the record before the run, so the fake proxy is unchanged.
- The shared row lives in the frozen suite, where shared strong journals are already tested. MOE_FROZEN_TEST_ONLY runs it in seconds, so it fits the 20-minute gate; the human chose to include it.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- receipt_replay (moe-agent.sh ~6595) and Invoke-MoeReceiptReplay (moe-agent.ps1 ~2416): receipt_send runs before the phase read, so every row that reaches the phase read re-sends the receipt.
- The phase comes from .moe/attempts/<id>.json; it reads 'mismatch' when the record is missing, unreadable or holds another identity. On finalizing, finalize_attempt is tried 3 times: success sets the phase to closed, failure prints the 'still finalizing' warning and continues. Only another phase reaches the CQ-V08b check.
- Both wrappers run the replay right after the pre-flight claim, whatever it answered, and before the reattach of reconciling attempts.
- Fake proxy: FAKE_CLAIM_MODE=finalizing refuses (ATTEMPT_FINALIZING) only while a finalizing attempt of the seat exists, else answers hasNext:false. A taskless --no-loop run then exits 0 after MOE_TASKLESS_WAIT_SEC. '<tool>-refuse' leaves the attempt untouched.
- sr_check reads B from $TMP_DIR/sg-base, which every sg_fixture run rewrites. Rows that replay the SR-T2 kept project must therefore run before SR-T3.
- The frozen suite is embedded twice, byte-identical. MOE_FROZEN_TEST_ONLY runs only the listed modes and exits 0 after them; a misspelled name runs nothing, hence the gate's 'scenarios: 2' count. postflight.ps1 checks $LASTEXITCODE before that exit.
- reconcile-strong-finalize-lost's run 1 (finalize_attempt-null) leaves the attempt finalizing, the strong journal on disk, one receipt and one committed completion row.
planningNotes.risks:
- The prerequisites (task-a1f3723f, task-edf2162b) land first and edit the same functions and harness sections. Re-find every anchor by text. If the lines printed on these paths changed, assert the landed text and say so.
- PS 5.1 traps: one-element results unroll (wrap them in @()), variable names are case-insensitive, postflight-vm-route.ps1 must stay ASCII, and edits must keep postflight.ps1's BOM and non-ASCII bytes.
- A mutant whose replace matched nothing 'survives' falsely: always diff the snapshot's wrapper against W before running it.
- Running the ps1 legs from /tmp, or with a leaked MOE_* env, breaks unrelated rows. checkRefs[0] cds to W on D: and unsets those variables.
- Never run mutants in W: shell writes leave no TOOL witness and would land. Put snapshots under /mnt/d/moe-scratch with fresh names; the safety check refuses rm -rf of a variable path.
- The plan's error handling for a red gate: read the leg's log, rerun that harness alone, and tell WSL interop from a real test failure.
